reporting-org.narrative: FMO NV (Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V.)

description.narrative: This project aims to improve access to green technology (clean/efficient cook stoves, solar panels etc) for those living in (energy) poverty. To do so, GP will work via their MFI partners/investees in Latin America to combine access to clean technology with affordable credit, aiming to save households and small businesses time and money, and to improve the quality of life of those people. Specifically GP will seek to provide knowledge transfer to (and between) partners to develop sustainable business models, and to utilise its network to identify and replicate models that are working or that have potential to. The provision of CD will be utilised to support this knowledge capture and transfer.
